title: Rootless and namespace boundaries
summary: Rootless Engine uses a user daemon and user-specific socket. User service lifecycle, runtime-directory cleanup, UID mappings and namespace restrictions can affect access independently of a system daemon.
checks: Check the explicitly declared user socket and user service.
Correlate user-session lifecycle and capability evidence; keep host and container vantages distinct.
limitations: This collector neither discovers contexts nor enters namespaces; remote and Windows endpoints are unsupported.
